composite_controller_specific_configs._comment_vla: VLA deploy for the REFERENCE-MOTION model: the GR00T policy predicts the SONIC encoder INPUT (24 SMPL joint positions = 72-D), not the token. We run the FULL POSE encoder (mode_id=2) -> decoder: composite_controller.set_vla_action(smpl_joints=...) pushes the prediction into the encoder via set_pose_control_var, then .step() encodes+decodes it. anchor/wrist are left at the POSE controller's defaults (identity / zero) since the model doesn't predict them. Finger joints are PD-driven to the policy's predicted left/right hand joints. No PICO, no kPlanner.
composite_controller_specific_configs._comment_paths: ckpt paths resolved by resolve_ckpt_path() -- absolute paths used as-is, otherwise relative to the SIM2REAL repo root ($SIM2REAL_ROOT, else the installed sim2real package). Checkpoints are never kept in this repo. Unlike sonic_vla, BOTH encoder and decoder run every step.
